target.title: fix(feishu): cap sender-name and streaming token caches
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes two unbounded in-process caches in the Feishu plugin:

1. **`senderNameCache`** in `bot-sender-name.ts` — stores resolved bot display names keyed by `botToken`. Each distinct token is a permanent `Map` entry; no eviction path exists.
2. **`tokenCache`** in `streaming-card.ts` — stores per-`{agentId, runId}` tenant access tokens for streaming card updates. Entries are never evicted; on a multi-agent Feishu instance the Map grows for every agent run.

## Why This Change Was Made

Applies `pruneMapToMaxSize` (from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/collection-runtime`) after every cache-set call:

| Cache | Cap | File |
|-------|-----|------|
| `senderNameCache` | 500 | `bot-sender-name.ts` |
| `tokenCache` | 256 | `streaming-card.ts` |

`senderNameCache` uses a named `cacheFeishuSenderName` wrapper helper to keep call sites clean. `tokenCache` uses an inline `pruneMapToMaxSize` call immediately after `tokenCache.set`.

**Changed files:** 4 files, +81 lines / −2 lines

```
extensions/feishu/src/bot-sender-name.ts       +16 / -1
extensions/feishu/src/bot-sender-name.test.ts  +19 / -1
extensions/feishu/src/streaming-card.ts        +10
extensions/feishu/src/streaming-card.test.ts   +38
```

## User Impact

Operators running Feishu channels on long-lived gateways get bounded memory for both lookup caches. Behavior is identical for normal workloads.

## Evidence

**New regression tests (run on `fix/feishu-cap-sender-and-token-caches`):**

- `bot-sender-name.test.ts` — *"evicts oldest sender name cache entries once the cache exceeds its cap"*: fills with 501 entries, verifies entry 0 is re-fetched after eviction.
- `streaming-card.test.ts` — *"evicts oldest streaming token cache entries once the cache exceeds its cap"*: fills with 257 `{agentId, runId}` entries, verifies the oldest is evicted.

**Local test run (both test files on `fix/feishu-cap-sender-and-token-caches`):**

```
pnpm node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run \
  --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-feishu.config.ts \
  extensions/feishu/src/bot-sender-name.test.ts \
  extensions/feishu/src/streaming-card.test.ts

Test Files  2 passed (2)
     Tests  25 passed (25)
  Duration  2.00s
```
